recent_calls.summary: The user, Michelle Saffo, called to request a standard hot water heater installation at her property in Saint Peters, Missouri. She explained her current water heater is leaking and has no hot water but indicated it is not an emergency. The agent provided information about the service fee and explained that a representative would follow up with a full quote, but the user decided to call back later for pricing details.

Angie called to request service for her air conditioner which had stopped working and mentioned she has a warranty. The agent confirmed her details, scheduled the service as soon as possible, and Angie expressed interest in receiving information about home maintenance programs. The call ended with the agent assuring Angie that someone would contact her soon to assist.

The user called to schedule a service appointment for air conditioning that is not cooling properly. The agent confirmed the issue, noted the request for the first available appointment, and assured the user that the team would confirm the appointment on the next business day. The user was satisfied with the prompt callback and gave positive feedback.

The user called after hours and requested to speak with a live agent. The assistant informed the user that live agents were unavailable and offered to take information, but the user hung up shortly after.

The user called urgently to discuss a quote needed for State Farm to indicate they do not have a livable house and require accommodation. The agent explained that no live agent was available after hours but documented the user's situation and assured a representative would follow up on the next business day.
The call was very brief with only the agent greeting the user and no further interaction. The user hung up shortly after the greeting without providing any information or request.
